title: Erasmus Mundus Application Roadmap and Live QnA
subtitle: From Planning to Submission
description: Ahnaf Farhan will share his own journey and guide you through the lessons, strategies, and steps that helped him navigate the Erasmus Mundus application process.
mentorHeading: Learn from someone who has already done it.
mentorBio: Md. Ahnaf Farhan is an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master’s student currently studying Communications Engineering and Data Science at Aalto University, Finland, with his next study destination at Grenoble INP, France. Through his own application journey, he learned how important programme selection, profile positioning, and strategic preparation are when applying for Erasmus Mundus. In this session, he will share the lessons and approaches that helped him secure his Erasmus Mundus opportunity.
